moat_justification: Moderate, time-limited patent moat: Jakafi is entrenched in myelofibrosis/PV/GVHD with pricing power and U.S. generic protection until December 2028 (litigation settlement plus pediatric exclusivity), and ruxolitinib extends into dermatology via Opzelura, the first topical JAK inhibitor, growing +24% underlying. Against that: Jakafi is over 60% of revenue and faces generic erosion from December 2028, JAK-class safety overhang and direct competition (GSK Ojjaara, AbbVie/Lilly systemics), pipeline/binary risk on the replacement story, IRA pricing pressure, and a persistent ~$252M TTM SBC load. Net cash funds the transition, but no asset yet replaces Jakafi at scale.
name: Incyte Corporation
one_liner: Quality net-cash biopharma, moat 5/10 — does not clear 15% at $113.78 (weighted IRR 12.1%, IV@15% $84.32) because the December 2028 Jakafi cliff sits inside the forecast window; it clears 15% at $84.32.
